simulation_config:
simulation:
  name: Genesis Simulation
  description: Emergent social complexity through LLM-driven agents
  era_prompt: stone age tribes
  seed: 42
world:
  width: 64
  height: 64
  terrain_types:
  - water
  - grassland
  - forest
  - mountain
  - desert
  resources:
    water:
      abundance: 0.3
      clustering: 0.7
    food:
      abundance: 0.4
      clustering: 0.6
    wood:
      abundance: 0.25
      clustering: 0.8
    stone:
      abundance: 0.2
      clustering: 0.9
    metal:
      abundance: 0.05
      clustering: 0.95
agents:
  count: 10
  spawn_radius: 5
  attributes:
    health:
      min: 80
      max: 100
    strength:
      min: 5
      max: 15
    intelligence:
      min: 5
      max: 15
    charisma:
      min: 5
      max: 15
  starting_inventory:
    food: 5
    water: 5
llm:
  provider: deepseek
  model: gpt-3.5-turbo
  temperature: 0.7
  max_tokens: 500
  rate_limit:
    requests_per_minute: 60
    burst_limit: 10
  cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl: 3600
    max_size: 10000
trinity:
  observation_interval: 10
  skill_generation_threshold: 3
  event_trigger_probability: 0.1
  age_progression_threshold: 0.8
memory:
  personal_capacity: 100
  cultural_capacity: 1000
  decay_factor: 0.95
runtime:
  max_turns: 1000
  turn_delay: 0.1
  log_level: INFO
  save_interval: 50
output:
  format: rich
  show_map: true
  show_stats: true
  export_web: false
  web_port: 8080
